userReportedInterruption: Disk space interruption. Exact OS cause of browser termination is not independently established.
touchRootCause: Nearby slider targets moved less than native Chromium touch slop; the trusted pointer gesture did not activate. The exact target and six-key correction assertions correctly rejected the unchanged value.
repair: After touchStart, move through the farther measured calibration point before the actual target. No synthetic DOM events, direct range setters, protocol changes or increased correction bound.
